mentions.name: Breadboard Helper
mentions.description: A 'breadboard helper' learning kit consisting of a written manual paired with a small PCB and breadboard. It guides users through wiring over a dozen transistor logic circuits, providing step-by-step instructions and explanations, inspired by classic Forrest Mims III, Don Lancaster, and 75-in-1 style electronics project kits. The author plans to sell them.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists playing with and learning electronics
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm finishing up the written manual portion of a "breadboard helper" for playing with (learning) electronics. The current "helper" I am finishing up gives you instructions (and an explanation) for wiring up over a dozen transistor logic circuits with the aid of a small PCB + breadboard [1].
